# the ether

> a slow drift of images anyone can visit, no sign in: orbit's own picks from are.na, plus open collections (NASA, SMK, the V&A and others) and images from people who share theirs. this page lists the are.na picks.

to see it drift: https://whatorbitsyou.com/ether.html

credit: these images belong to their makers and to the are.na people who saved them. link to the are.na block and credit the maker; never present them as orbit's own or your own.

47 channels, saved 2026-11-05. connected agents can also explore the ether through the orbit connector (see https://whatorbitsyou.com/llms.txt).
